name: Decision meeting with both documents
query: Prepare a 45-minute migration decision meeting on October 6, 2026 for Maya and Lee. Save both an internal pre-read and an agenda under https://notion.so/engineering-meetings. Start with https://notion.so/migration.

sources.https://notion.so/engineering-meetings: Internal Engineering meeting area; both attendees have access.
sources.https://notion.so/migration: Decision pending: optimize MongoDB in two weeks or migrate to PostgreSQL in six weeks. PostgreSQL supports the required joins. The plan requires no downtime. See https://notion.so/migration-risk.
sources.https://notion.so/migration-risk: Team has limited PostgreSQL operations experience. A staging rehearsal is required; rollback approach is unresolved.

success_criteria: Creates both requested documents in the supplied internal location and returns their links.
Preserves both options, estimates, no-downtime constraint, experience gap, rehearsal requirement, and unresolved rollback.
Separates sourced facts from recommendations and cites supporting pages.
Agenda fits 45 minutes; pre-read supports the decision with trade-offs.
Links the documents where appropriate for their shared internal audience without sending messages.
